title: Debounced search input with abort and stale-response guard
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (expanded clean stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer may flag the swallowed AbortError as error hiding, or the request-id check as redundant next to abort. Both guards are needed: aborting the previous request stops its network work, but a response already in flight can still resolve afterwards, so the monotonically increasing request id is what guarantees only the latest query renders. Non-abort failures are not swallowed — they put a visible error message in the results region. The detach function removes the listener, clears the pending timer, and aborts in-flight work.
